title: Release channel compatibility mapper and orchestrated migration coordinator for Private
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Summary: Implement a compatibility mapping service and a migration coordinator to enable orchestrated, low-downtime upgrades across Redwood Private deployments (VPC/on-prem). The work covers: (1) a lightweight compatibility/contract mapper that encodes which runtime/database/schema/agent combinations can safely coexist for a given major/minor version; (2) a migration coordinator that sequences multi-node schema and agent upgrades, enforces rollout gates, supports staged canaries and automatic rollback on regression signals, and exposes hooks for ops and console rollouts. Scope excludes cloud-hosted API changes and focuses on Private control plane and agent interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility mapper service responds to compatibility queries for any pair of release channels with <=200ms median latency
Migration coordinator can execute a staged canary (1%, 10%, 100%) for a 10-node private cluster and roll back automatically based on defined SLO regressions
Operator can define rollout gates by metric (latency, error-rate, token-cost) and time-window via the Console UI or CLI
Automated preflight checks (version skew, schema diff, disk space, migration downtime estimate) run and fail fast with human-readable diagnostics
All migration steps are recorded to upgrade audit log and exposed via /admin/upgrade/{run_id} endpoint
Unit + integration tests covering compatibility mapping rules, coordinator failure modes, and rollback paths are present with >=90% coverage for core modules
Performance regression threshold alarms configured and an automatic fallback policy exists to switch to a compatible model variant when capacity is constrained
implementation_notes: Compatibility model: represent compatibility as a short immutable descriptor (channel:major.minor+build -> list of supported agents, schema version, kv-cache-format). Keep mapping in a single source-of-truth service (read-optimized) backed by git-style channel manifests.
Coordinator: use existing job orchestration framework (upgrade-runner) but add an idempotent step model, step-level timeouts, and compensating actions for partial failures.
Safety gates: integrate with Console's metrics API; define a Gate DSL (threshold, window, metric, action). Initial gate types: latency_p95, error_rate_1m, migration_duration.
Telemetry: emit upgrade.run.start, upgrade.step.complete, upgrade.step.error, upgrade.rollback.triggered with tags (cluster_id, channel_from, channel_to, step_id).
Backwards-compatibility: ensure agents can serve requests while control plane components upgrade; implement dual-write mode for critical control-plane flags during transition.
Data migrations: separate schema migrations into online-friendly transforms where possible; for offline migrations provide an explicit maintenance window and an abort path.
migration_plan: Phase 0 - Preflight: run compatibility queries, schema diff, disk & resource checks, and notify stakeholders via Slack channel #private-upgrades
Phase 1 - Canary: apply agent + control-plane changes to 1 node, run smoke tests and perf microbenchmarks for 30 minutes
Phase 2 - Broad canary: expand to 10% of nodes, run e2e traffic replay using preserved KV prefixes and observe SLOs for 2 hours
Phase 3 - Ramp: expand to 50% with automated throttling if gate triggers, allow manual hold and inspection
Phase 4 - Full rollout: complete remaining nodes and mark run success when post-checks pass for 24 hours
Abort/rollback: if any gate triggers or critical error occurs, trigger compensating steps to restore previous channel via compatibility mapper and invoke rollback playbook
rollout_plan: Operators create UpgradeRun via Console or CLI that references source_channel and target_channel and optionally a custom gate list
UpgradeRun is validated by preflight checks and assigned a run_id; Console displays expected downtime and estimated duration
Run proceeds automatically through phases; automated notifications sent at transitions and on gate failures
Provide a manual 'pause' and 'resume' control in the Console for mid-run interventions
Post-mortem trigger: if rollback executed, run auto-collection of logs and attach to the UpgradeRun record
qa_checks: Automated smoke tests run against canary node within 5 minutes of applied changes
Load profile replay with 95th percentile token throughput matching baseline within +-10%
Schema-consistency checker validates no orphaned columns/indices post-migration
Chaos tests: simulate agent restart during mid-step and ensure coordinator resumes or rolls back cleanly
